game.taqriban.title: Taqriban!
game.taqriban.howto.1: The TV asks a question whose answer is a number. Nobody knows it exactly.
game.taqriban.howto.2: Type your best guess on your phone. The thousand, million and billion buttons help with huge numbers.
game.taqriban.howto.3: Every guess lands on a number line, then the real answer drops in. Closest wins 1,000 points.
game.taqriban.howto.4: Within 2 percent? Bullseye bonus! The last question counts double.
game.taqriban.rules.guess.title: Guess
game.taqriban.rules.guess.body: One guess per question, locked once you send it. Watch the units in the question (metres, km, people…).
game.taqriban.rules.closest.title: Closest wins
game.taqriban.rules.closest.body: For answers of 100 or more, closeness is a ratio: guessing half is as far as guessing double. Below 100, it is the plain difference. Tied guesses all win.
game.taqriban.rules.points.title: Points
game.taqriban.rules.points.body: Closest guess: 1,000 points. Bullseye (within 2 percent of the answer): 500 more, even if someone else was closer.
game.taqriban.rules.final.title: Final question
game.taqriban.rules.final.body: The last question counts double. Ties in the standings go to whoever won more questions, then more Bullseyes.
game.taqriban.coach.question: Type a number, check the preview, then lock it in.
game.taqriban.coach.reveal: Eyes on the TV: where did the real answer land?
game.taqriban.coach.hold: Waiting for players to come back.
game.taqriban.pause.skip.confirm: Replace this question with another one?
game.taqriban.pause.endGame.confirm: End the game and show the final standings?
game.taqriban.phone.timeUp: Time's up! No guess this time.
game.taqriban.phone.waitingNext: You're in from the next question.
game.taqriban.phone.hold: The game is paused until a player comes back.
game.taqriban.show.question: Question {n} of {total}
game.taqriban.show.finalIntro.title: Final question!
game.taqriban.show.finalIntro.body: Double points. Everything can still change.
game.taqriban.show.results.title: Final standings
game.taqriban.show.results.tie: It's a tie at the top!
game.taqriban.show.endedEarly: The questions are no longer available: the game ended early.
game.taqriban.error.alreadyGuessed: You already locked in a guess.
game.taqriban.error.valueInvalid: Type a number between 0 and a quadrillion.
